resolution.title: Add a reviewed tool contract
resolution.detail: Somite recognized a paper method but does not yet have a reviewed contract for its inputs, command, and outputs.

recipes.title: Draft a reviewed operator contract
recipes.summary: Turn retained method evidence into a typed, tested operator instead of guessing from a package name.
steps: Locate the authoritative tool source and version named by the paper.
Record typed inputs, arguments, outputs, and installation requirements.
Add a representative fixture and replace this gap only after validation.
